items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: Because he was with Joe Abraham Tillman, I think.

ctx.x: I got a soprano from the store and kept it two leasing and gave it back. Well, that's pretty much like Mealy Barnes. He won't play one. And I think George gave his away there, huh?

I think so. He don't like it. He had one. Just not necessary. It's too much difference. He was in the band. He was in the band. He was in the band. Who was with Omar Bernard's band? Buddy Bernard, he was on the band, Joe. I believe Rodgers, who died. He used to live on the main street. It's a drummer? Yeah. Ernest Rodgers? Ernest Rodgers. He was on the drum. And ever heard of Ambrose, the drum roll? Yeah. Yeah. Thomas Tophie's uncle. That's right. He was on drum roll. Bass. From that age, I think he was on bass.…
You said that was a dance album? It was a dance? Yeah, it was a dance. What, did they sell tickets? Yeah.
